findings.text: the run's manifest is four lines and records no commits, no tests command, no test_logs, no baseline_suite/after_suite arm as inline JSON, no per-cause verdict and no negative-control log, so the done_when's own manifest clauses are unmet and a promotion reading this receipt finds no gate to re-run; its orientation_worktree line is also `/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/.reckon-worktrees/receipt 2>/dev/null`, a shell fragment rather than a path.

commit da98e975eed930a8272ac49214c8f7217d0676d3, which adds this fragment, carries no message body (`git log -1 --format=%b` returns a single newline), and the repository rule makes a bodiless commit a review failure; the repair is one amend, not a code change.

the fragment quotes `[24_495_394, 1_644_077, 900_000]` while tests/test_rollout_receipt.py:773 writes `[24_495_394, 900_000, 1_644_077]`, so the stated fold `readings[0] + (last - readings[1])` evaluates to 23,751,317 rather than the 25,239,471 the case asserts and a reader checking the evidence against the code gets a value that cannot pass.

the fragment says "The head run is the gate log named in the manifest" while the manifest at manifest.md names no log at all, so the pointer resolves to nothing and the only record of the head arm is the run directory's head-arm-1795065495643901714.log.

the third base failing id is recorded as `test_real_named_rollout_cumulative` where the full id the log's verbatim id at logs/base-tests-test_rollout_receipt.log:81 is `test_real_named_rollout_cumulative_beats_naive_single_readings`, so the "verbatim from that log" claim is false and the id cannot be matched against the recorded failure.

`files_found` is computed and only printed at :468, while every assertion in the case from :457 is guarded by isinstance, so a regression that made read_rollout_receipt answer Unmeasured.MISSING_ROLLOUT for the fixture sessions would leave the case green reporting "rollout retention: 0/12"; an `assert files_found == len(session_ids)` is the floor the fixture exists to guarantee.

`assert 1 < share < 99` is entailed by the selection filter at :746 `if 3 < share < 97` applied to the same generation/machine pair, so the line can never fail on its own and the documented (1, 99) band is decided by the filter, not by this assertion.
